inputs.text: These Phoenix city leaders are pushing yet another scheme to hamstring federal immigration enforcement, with the city council voting Wednesday night to slap new restrictions on ICE and other law enforcement using city property. This is the same old resistance to national authority, where local officials prioritize open borders over the rule of law and the safety of American families. By tying the hands of federal agents, they're inviting more chaos at the border and eroding the basic duty to protect our sovereignty and cultural heritage. It's a clear sign of misplaced priorities that weaken traditional order in favor of activist posturing.
